headline: Senior Information Security Analyst | CISSP | CISM
summary: Dedicated Information Security professional with over 10 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, risk management, and regulatory compliance. Proven track record in securing financial systems and enterprise infrastructure within the Nepalese market. Specialized in SIEM implementation, ISO 27001 standards, and incident response.

experiences.title: Senior Security Engineer
description: Lead threat hunting operations and advanced incident response for enterprise clients.
Design and optimize security orchestration and automation (SOAR) playbooks.
Execute regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing across cloud environments.

experiences.title: Information Security Officer
description: Managed Information Security (IS) audits and internal compliance monitoring.
Implemented ISO 27001:2013 standards and security frameworks for banking operations.
Supervised network security infrastructure and firewall configuration management.

experiences.title: Junior System Administrator
description: Performed daily system monitoring and log analysis for security anomalies.
